coverage: VolumeNotification sent through named-pipe IPC and EngineControl write-through
temporary approximately −3 dB attenuation on the Windows endpoint

limitations: This is an explicitly user-invoked user-space Engine Preview IPC-to-IAudioEndpointVolume write-through probe; it does not prove a Hibiki virtual endpoint, WaveRT/PortCls driver, physical DSP playback, HLK or Microsoft signing.
